pool.text: Pigafetta visited Brunei during Ferdinand Magellan's last voyages.
Catholic Spaniards attacked Kampong Ayer during the Castilian War.
Rajah James Brooke dubbed Kampong Ayer a Venice of hovels.
Chinese immigrants opened shops establishing the colony on land.
The area was officially designated as Brunei capital and municipal territory.
The Brunei Town Sanitary Board was established to oversee development.
The Sanitary Board converted into the current Municipal Board achieving bandaran status.
Japanese forces launched an assault and overran Brunei Town.
American and Australian forces captured Brunei after three days of warfare.
A board of 19 notable individuals was formed for Islamic matters.
A major development plan introduced funding for infrastructure and growth.
Brunei population tripled as a result of immigration from oilfield finds.
The Brunei revolt began when the North Kalimantan National Army captured Brunei Town.
Pusat Belia youth centre was established after being commissioned by Crown Prince Hassanal Bolkiah.
Brunei Town was formally renamed Bandar Seri Begawan in honour of the Sultan.
Sultan Hassanal Bolkiah declared Brunei independence at a square in the city centre.
Bandar Seri Begawan served as the host city of the 20th Southeast Asian Games.
Bandar Seri Begawan hosted the 8th APEC Summit.
Sultan Haji Hassanal Bolkiah Silver Jubilee Park opened celebrating his reign.
The Sultan Haji Omar Ali Saifuddien Bridge opened providing connectivity to Temburong.
